caption:
Lasting good deeds: read this before your day starts

Wealth and children are a beauty of this life, but Allah tells us the lasting righteous deeds are better with Him, in reward and in hope. Start today with one deed that lasts.

Surah Al-Kahf 18:46

Pick one lasting good deed to do before noon today

#gooddeeds #righteousdeeds #muslimhabits #quranreels

Recitation: Yasser Al-Dosari
